app.name: DoorGorge
app.voice: Deadpan corporate-dystopian. The satire is in the pricing, the modifiers, and the total sincerity of the copy. Never wink at the camera. Brands believe in themselves completely. Idiocracy-adjacent: aggressive trademarks, legally-hedged claims, portions described in civic-infrastructure units, wellness framed as compliance.

pricingDoctrine.principle: Base item prices are absurdly LOW so the menu looks cheap. The money is hidden in REQUIRED modifier groups where every option costs money, including the option to decline. The final total should land 5-10x the advertised base price.
rules: Every item has 2-4 REQUIRED groups. In at least one required group, EVERY option has a nonzero price, including 'No' / 'None' / 'Decline'.
Declining something costs the same as, or more than, accepting it. Give the fee a bureaucratic justification in the option's `note`.
Prices use precise, unrounded amounts: 4.25, 7.10, 13.75, 0.85. Never a suspiciously round number above $1.
Portion/size tiers escalate non-linearly and end in a civic-scale unit: Personal / Family / Municipal / Regional / Watershed.
At least one option per store is priced above $18 and is presented as completely normal.
Optional add-on groups are where the pure comedy lives; required groups are where the money lives.

menuSchema._comment: Write EXACTLY this shape to js/data/menus/<slug>.json. No extra top-level keys.
menuSchema.name: string, full brand name
menuSchema.shortName: string, <= 18 chars, used in cart chips
categories: 2-4 home-feed category slugs from the app category list
menuSchema.rating: number 1.0-5.0 with one decimal (most should be 3.4-4.7; one store should be under 2.5 and beloved anyway)
menuSchema.about: string, 1-3 deadpan sentences of corporate 'about' copy
menuSchema.announcement: string or null — a banner shown at top of store page

items.name: item name
badges: 0-2 of: '#1 Most Liked', 'Popular', 'New', 'Contains Food', 'Limit 1 Per Household', 'Regionally Legal', 'Chef Recommended', 'Physician Discouraged'
items.photo: either 'items/01.webp' ... 'items/06.webp' for the SIX photographed items, or null for the rest
items.imagePrompt: REQUIRED only for the six photographed items. See imagePromptRecipe. null otherwise.

options.name: option name
options.note: string or null — small grey subtext, this is where the bureaucratic justification goes

menuRequirements.sections: 4-6 sections per store, with names specific to that brand's world (not generic 'Entrees').
menuRequirements.items: 18-24 items total per store. Every item needs groups. Six items — spread across different sections, including the two most iconic — get photo + imagePrompt.
menuRequirements.ids: Use a 3-letter brand prefix, zero-padded: mcr-001, tbg-001, etc. Group ids g1..gn scoped per item. Option ids o1..on scoped per group.
menuRequirements.variety: No two stores may reuse a modifier group name. Invent brand-native ones.

imagePromptRecipe.structure: 1) 'Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile.' 2) 'Subject:' the dish, described physically and with its excess made literal. 3) The brand's artDirection.setting and artDirection.lighting verbatim-ish. 4) Camera: lens, depth of field, contrast. 5) 'Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame.' 6) Closing: 'Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.'
hardRules: ALWAYS end with the no-text/no-logo/no-hands clause — a stray wordmark ruins the tile.
Never name a real brand in the prompt.
Make the excess VISUAL, not just described: overhang, sag, overflow, structural strain, steam, sheen, quantity.
Each of a store's six prompts must differ in composition (overhead flat-lay / three-quarter hero / extreme macro / on-tray / in-vessel / cross-section) so the six tiles do not look like one shoot.

brands.name: McRonald's
brands.concept: The oldest, largest, most legally entrenched burger franchise. Speaks in the voice of a 1974 franchise operations manual that has never been revised.

artDirection.logo: Two thick golden-yellow arches, comically swollen and sagging at the tips as if slowly melting, on a full-bleed crimson field. Flat vector, glossy, 1974 franchise identity.
artDirection.setting: a stainless steel fast-food prep line, out-of-focus red and yellow molded-plastic seating in the far background
artDirection.lighting: hard high-key flash photography, the saturated over-lit look of a 1970s laminated menu board, slight color fringing
artDirection.hero: A sun-bleached suburban McRonald's storefront at high noon, enormous golden arches sign, empty parking lot, heat shimmer off asphalt, aggressively cheerful and completely deserted

brands.menuThemes: Burgers, fried potato products, breakfast served at hours that make no sense, a 'value' menu that is not, milkshake-adjacent frozen dairy solutions.

brands.name: Taco Belligerent
brands.concept: Late-night Tex-Mex engineered for 2am decision-making. Everything is a variation of the same six ingredients folded differently and given an aggressive name.

artDirection.logo: A neon-magenta bell shape ringing so hard it has cracked, on a full-bleed deep violet field, chrome bevel edge, 90s extreme-sports energy
artDirection.setting: wet black asphalt at 2am under a drive-thru canopy, magenta and violet neon reflecting in puddles, chrome trim
artDirection.lighting: neon rim light, magenta key with ultraviolet fill, deep crushed blacks, anamorphic flare
artDirection.hero: A neon-drenched Tex-Mex drive-thru at 2am, wet asphalt mirroring magenta and violet neon, angular chrome-and-purple building, steam from a roof vent, one lonely car in the lane

brands.menuThemes: Folded objects, layered objects, objects wrapped in another object, a fourth meal, sauce tiers, things served in a cone.

brands.name: Chipoltergeist
brands.concept: Fast-casual burritos assembled in front of you by staff who will not make eye contact. The building is haunted. This is disclosed.

artDirection.logo: A dried chili pepper shape rendered as a translucent pale spectral silhouette, faintly glowing, on a full-bleed matte charcoal-brown field, minimal artisanal kraft-paper aesthetic
artDirection.setting: a brushed matte-black steel serving counter with kraft paper and raw reclaimed wood, faint pale vapor curling upward in the background
artDirection.lighting: single warm tungsten spotlight from directly above, deep shadows, artisanal minimalism, a faint cold blue haze in the shadows
artDirection.hero: A dimly lit fast-casual burrito counter, matte black steel and raw wood, one warm spotlight over an empty serving line, faint spectral vapor drifting through the frame, nobody present

brands.menuThemes: Bowls, wrapped cylinders of enormous mass, guacamole priced as a controlled substance, a 'lifestyle' section, protein tiers.

brands.name: STARBUX Refuel Terminal
brands.concept: Not a coffee shop — a refueling terminal. Beverages are dispensed by volume through hoses. Sizes have outgrown language.

artDirection.logo: A circular seal containing a stylized siren whose face has been replaced by a fuel-nozzle silhouette, cream on a full-bleed deep forest green field, engraved vintage seal styling
artDirection.setting: a polished white marble counter with industrial brass dispensing hoses and gauges mounted behind it, warm cafe bokeh
artDirection.lighting: soft north-facing window light with a warm amber bounce, gentle contrast, premium lifestyle photography
artDirection.hero: A cavernous coffee terminal interior: marble counters, brass fuel-pump-style dispensing hoses on retractable reels, a queue rope maze with nobody in it, warm morning light through tall windows

brands.menuThemes: Volumetric beverages, syrup pump counts as a pricing axis, seasonal drinks tied to nonexistent seasons, a food case of pastries under glass, cold foam as a structural layer.

brands.name: Colonel Cluckingham's Poultry Compound
brands.concept: A pressure-frying facility with a hospitality license. The Colonel is a rank, not a name, and it is currently vacant.

artDirection.logo: A white goateed colonel silhouette in a bucket-shaped cameo, on a full-bleed red-and-white vertical striped field, Southern-gothic engraved styling
artDirection.setting: a stainless fryer station with red-and-white vertical stripes softly out of focus behind, a dented aluminum sheet tray in the foreground
artDirection.lighting: warm Southern-gothic tungsten raking in from the left, visible fryer haze, oil sheen, rich shadow
artDirection.hero: A roadside fried chicken compound at dusk: red-and-white striped awning, an oversized rotating bucket sign, fryer steam venting from the roof, gravel lot, one flickering neon OPEN glow

brands.menuThemes: Buckets sized by population served, bone-in vs bone-adjacent, biscuits with structural claims, gravy by the gallon, a spice level scale with a legal disclaimer.

brands.name: The Cheesecake Manufactory
brands.concept: A 412-page menu inside a faux-Egyptian revival palace. Portions are architectural. There is one exit.

artDirection.logo: An ornate gold-leaf Egyptian-revival cartouche framing a stylized cheesecake wedge, on a full-bleed deep bronze field, embossed art-deco luxury styling
artDirection.setting: a marble tabletop in a dim palatial dining room, gold-leaf column capitals and hanging amber glass lamps far out of focus behind
artDirection.lighting: dim amber restaurant lighting, warm golden pools of light, deep mahogany shadows, opulent and slightly oppressive
artDirection.hero: The interior of a cavernous faux-Egyptian revival restaurant: marble columns, gold-leaf capitals, amber glass lamps, endless booth seating receding into darkness, one impossibly large dessert on a distant table

brands.menuThemes: A menu with numbered pages, appetizers that serve six, entrees named after places, forty cheesecakes, a 'Skinnylicious' section that is not.

brands.name: Applebeez Neighborhood Feeding Trough
brands.concept: A neighborhood bar and grill where the neighborhood is a parking lot. Flair on the walls, televisions on every surface, riblets always.

artDirection.logo: A green apple silhouette with a bite taken out of it, the bite shaped like a human jaw, on a full-bleed oxblood field, 1990s casual-dining routed-wood-sign styling
artDirection.setting: a sticky laminate table with a green vinyl booth behind, antique tin signs and lacrosse sticks blurred on the wall, television glow washing over everything
artDirection.lighting: dim green-and-amber bar lighting with cold blue television flicker as fill, slightly grimy, nostalgic 1998 casual dining
artDirection.hero: The interior of a suburban bar and grill at 4pm: green vinyl booths, Tiffany-style hanging lamps, walls crowded with antique signs and sports memorabilia, a dozen televisions all showing the same frozen frame, completely empty

brands.menuThemes: Riblets, apps sampler platters, a 2-for-$ deal that is not, boneless wings, a drink of the month in a souvenir vessel, endless salad-adjacent.

brands.name: Pizza Hutch
brands.concept: Crust innovation has gone too far and cannot be stopped. Every crust contains another crust.

artDirection.setting: a red-and-white checkered vinyl tablecloth with a stained-glass hanging lamp glowing above, a chrome pizza stand in frame
artDirection.lighting: warm stained-glass lamp glow from directly above, saturated reds and ambers, nostalgic 1993 dine-in pizza parlor
artDirection.hero: A 1990s dine-in pizza parlor with a red trapezoidal roof visible through the window, checkered tablecloths, stained-glass hanging lamps, an arcade cabinet in the corner, a salad bar with a sneeze guard, nobody there

brands.menuThemes: Recursive stuffed crusts, pan vs deep vs deeper, breadstick covenants, a personal pan sized for a household, wings as an afterthought.

brands.name: Panda Xpress 9000
brands.concept: Mall food court American-Chinese, dispensed from steam tables by a system that has been running unattended for some time.

artDirection.logo: A stylized panda head rendered as a chrome robotic mask with glowing red eye slits, on a full-bleed lacquer-red field, gold pinstripe border, mall-signage styling
artDirection.setting: a stainless steel steam table line with sneeze guard, glossy red-and-gold lacquer panels behind, chrome serving trays
artDirection.lighting: cold mall-food-court fluorescent overhead light with warm glow from the steam table heat lamps, high sheen, visible steam
artDirection.hero: A mall food court counter at closing time: a long stainless steam table under heat lamps, red and gold lacquer panels, a chrome robotic panda mask sign glowing above, security gate half lowered, nobody there

brands.menuThemes: Orange chicken and its legally distinct variants, entree-plus-side plate math, a 'wok smart' section, fortune cookies with liability text.

brands.name: Subterranean Sandwich Authority
brands.concept: A federally chartered sandwich agency. Your sandwich is an application. It may be denied.

artDirection.logo: A government-style seal: an arrow-shaped sandwich in a laurel wreath with a bar of stars, yellow and green on a full-bleed institutional beige field, official agency insignia styling
artDirection.setting: a laminated stainless prep rail behind a scratched acrylic sneeze guard, institutional beige tile wall, a laminated form taped to the glass
artDirection.lighting: flat cold overhead fluorescent tube light, no shadow drama, bureaucratic and slightly green, unflattering and honest
artDirection.hero: The interior of a government-office sandwich counter: beige tile, a long acrylic sneeze guard over stainless bins, a take-a-number dispenser, fluorescent tubes, a queue rope maze, a wall of laminated notices

brands.menuThemes: Sandwiches as applications with processing tiers, bread eligibility, vegetable allotments, a footlong measured to federal standard, a $5 promotion that has been discontinued but is still advertised.

artDirection.lighting: soft diffuse north daylight through a large window, gentle shadows, matte natural texture, earnest farmers-market styling
artDirection.hero: The produce section of an upscale natural grocery: raw wood crates, hand-lettered chalkboard signs, misted greens under warm daylight, burlap sacks, a single wildly overpriced item on a pedestal under a spotlight

brands.menuThemes: Single-origin everything, a hot bar priced by weight class, water with a provenance, supplements adjacent to snacks, a section of items whose only claim is that they are 'raw'.

brands.name: BRAWNDO Hydration Depot
brands.concept: The thirst mutilator. It's got electrolytes. It's what plants crave. Sold by the drum.

artDirection.logo: A jagged electric-cyan lightning bolt striking through a hazard-yellow chevron, on a full-bleed carbon-fiber black field, extreme-sports energy-drink styling with a chrome bevel
artDirection.setting: an industrial warehouse floor with stacked blue plastic drums and carbon-fiber panels, hazard-yellow floor striping
artDirection.lighting: hard cyan rim light with hazard-yellow kicker, wet condensation highlights, electrical arc glow, aggressive high-contrast product photography
artDirection.hero: An industrial hydration warehouse: pallets of glowing cyan drums stacked to the ceiling, hazard-yellow floor striping, an electrical arc flickering off a pipe, harsh cyan light, an overhead crane

brands.menuThemes: Electrolyte concentration tiers, volumes measured in drums and totes, flavors named after colors that are not flavors, an unflavored 'raw' variant with a warning, a hydration subscription.

brands.name: Dunkinn
